question: Which video processes herbs through mechanical blending rather than hand-chopping?

observed_information.statement: A woman in v1 places parsley on a cutting board and uses a knife to hand-chop green herbs.
Herbs in v2 are actively hand-chopped with a knife on a cutting board.
Herbs in v3 are chopped with a knife and a pile of chopped herbs is shown next to a food processor.
Chopped herbs in v3 are placed inside a food processor bowl and the machine is shown operating to blend the contents.
A woman or chef in v4 continues to hand-chop green herbs with a knife or large cleaver.
A blender containing green liquid is displayed in v4, but whether it is actively running is not visible.

working_relations.statement: All four videos contain visible knife-based herb chopping events, while only v3 also contains an event showing a machine operating to blend chopped herbs.
v3 shows a food processor operating on chopped herbs, whereas v4 shows a blender with green liquid but no visible active blending of herbs.
The supplied v1 and v2 events both show hand-chopped herbs and do not include an observed mechanical blending action.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether any herb processing in v1 occurs through mechanical blending rather than the observed hand-chopping remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: The supplied events show knife hand-chopping but no event shows herbs being placed into or processed by a blender or food processor.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether any herb processing in v2 occurs through mechanical blending rather than the observed hand-chopping remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: The supplied events show knife hand-chopping and note blending not visible, but they do not establish the absence of blending in unobserved portions.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether the blender containing green liquid in v4 is used to mechanically process herbs rather than the visible hand-chopping remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: The event shows a blender but not whether it is running or whether herbs are inside it, while other events show hand-chopping.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether v3 contains herb processing by mechanical blending independently of hand-chopping remains unresolved because both methods are visible.
unresolved_issues.reason: The events show knife chopping before blending, so it is not settled whether blending is the processing method for herbs or a step after hand-chopping.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare whether any v1 herbs are placed into a blender or food processor and the machine runs versus whether all herb processing shown is knife chopping.
candidate_requests.purpose: To determine whether v1 contains mechanical herb blending despite observed hand-chopping.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare whether any v2 herbs are placed into a blender or food processor and the machine runs versus whether all herb processing shown is knife chopping.
candidate_requests.purpose: To determine whether v2 contains mechanical herb blending despite observed hand-chopping.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare whether the v3 food processor blends unchopped herbs versus blending only herbs that were previously hand-chopped.
candidate_requests.purpose: To determine whether v3 contains herb processing by mechanical blending independently of hand-chopping.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare whether the v4 blender with green liquid is actively running with herbs versus merely displayed while herbs are hand-chopped.
candidate_requests.purpose: To determine whether v4 uses mechanical blending for herbs rather than hand-chopping.

validation_notes: 3 relations are evidence_partial: at least one video in scope either contributed no cited event or is still named by an unresolved issue
3 of those overlap an unresolved issue, so citing one event per video in scope was not enough to call them covered
